title: Parking Lot Horror [1]
description: 60 covered parking spaces, nine vehicles, three immunity gems. Two sliding minivans offer safe hiding. Survive five 60-second skeleton hunts separated by 60-second calm phases. Hold gems for protection. Key at gate after hunt five. Captured players spectate. Experimental: Quest multiplayer validation required.

levelNodeSign.text:
SPECTATOR — ELIMINATED
Watch the survivors through the garage window.

PARKING LOT HORROR
SURVIVE FIVE HUNTS — 10 PLAYERS

60 seconds calm / 60 seconds hunt. Five hunts only.
Touch blue car handles to open doors. HOLD a gem for immunity.
Blue van pads hide / leave. One player per van. Hiding protects you.
After the fifth hunt, collect the gold key at the gate.
Touch the lock, then cross the raised gate to escape.
